message.content:
# THE DORMANT BOARD

## ENTRY

The party enter the old complex.

Dim halls. No light. Grime hangs in the still air. The floor is cracked. The walls are blank.

The complex is not empty. Raiders lie in the halls. The party use skill.

## THE UNITS

The group see two units in the inner space. The units are off. Deactivated. Stiff metal faces stare at the group.

The units in old suits. The suits are cut. The faces are plain. No eye. No mouth. Blank metal.

These are CEO husks. Pre War units. Built to guide. Built to command. The top minds the old world built.

But the units are still. Off. Blank.

## THE VAULT

The group check the walls. The group see the vault. It has thick seals. The vault is set in stone.

After the seals: the vault. Pre War goods. Weapons. Med packs. Power cells. Items the party require.

The units alone can break it. The vault knows the units. The vault likes the units.

If the units start, the units act as CEO. The units speak command. The units require loyalty.

## THE QUEST

The startup input hides in the old files. The old files are digital. Set in old disks. The disks are cracked.

The party dig for the input. The quest is set.
